providers.title: The maximal prosolvable extension
providers.scope: Q^s is solvably closed and closed under radicals, lies in every solvably closed algebraic extension of Q, and contains every finite solvable Galois extension of a number field M in Q^s; abelian and additive characters of G_M factor through Gal(Q^s/M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uchida's conjecture (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For number fields F_1, F_2 and Galois extensions E_i/F_i with E_i solvably closed, every continuous homomorphism Gal(E_1/F_1) -> Gal(E_2/F_2) with open image is induced by a unique field embedding E_2 -> E_1. Proved in the eighth lesson; assumes the named inputs (U1), (U2) and (H).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trivial centralizers in Gal(Q^s/Q)
providers.scope: The only element of P = Gal(Q^s/Q) commuting with every element of an open subgroup of P is 1. Assumes (U1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sylow subgroups of profinite groups
providers.scope: Pro-l Sylow subgroups exist and are pro-l; every closed pro-l subgroup lies in one; any two are conjugate; surjections map them onto Sylow subgroups; they meet a closed normal pro-p subgroup (p != l) trivially. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local Galois groups inside the prosolvable closure
providers.scope: A decomposition group in G_M is isomorphic to the absolute Galois group of the completion, compatibly with inertia; for M in Q^s, restriction maps it isomorphically onto the decomposition group in Gal(Q^s/M). No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The norm identity
providers.scope: For an active pair (v, w) at an odd prime l, (Nv)^b(g) = (Nw)^a(g) in Z_l^x for every g in D_v, with b and a the source and target residue exponents. Assumes the pair given by (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cutting by a hypersurface
providers.scope: For a homogeneous prime p with dim S/p >= 1 and a homogeneous F not in p of degree d, every minimal prime of p + (F) has dimension one less, and the multiplicities of those other than the irrelevant ideal sum to at most d e(p). No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The component bound
providers.scope: The zero set in k^n of polynomials of total degree at most d has at most d^n irreducible components, and so does its intersection with the torus. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The l-adic logarithm rank theorem
providers.scope: If m > n(n-1) points u_i of (E^x)^n have coordinates that are algebraic integers and units of a finite extension K of Q_l, and every nontrivial product u^a has coordinates multiplicatively independent modulo roots of unity, then the logarithms log u_i span K^n. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A zero estimate on the torus
providers.scope: If (S+1)^m > (nD)^n, the matrix of values (u^a)^alpha, alpha in {0,...,D}^n and a in {0,...,nS}^m, has rank (D+1)^n. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Transfer of additive characters
providers.scope: Corestriction of additive characters is a well-defined homomorphism; cor(res x) = [G:H] x; for H normal, res(cor y) is the sum of the conjugates of y; corestriction is transitive; restriction is injective. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The class-field description of additive characters
providers.scope: X_l(M) is isomorphic to the linear forms on M (x) Q_l that vanish on the l-adic logarithms of the global units, compatibly with automorphisms, and lambda_x(log b) = -h x(Fr_v) when (b) = v^h. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Frobenius detection (OpenAI)
providers.scope: An additive l-adic character vanishing at Frobenius at infinitely many primes of absolute residue degree one is zero; with a fixed Frobenius class delta in a Galois M/Q one gets E_<delta> x = 0; a character with nonzero corestriction to Q vanishes at only finitely many Frobenius elements. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The signed representation
providers.scope: For M/Q finite, Galois and totally imaginary with group R and complex conjugation c, there are R-equivariant injections Q_l + Ind_<c>^R(sign) -> X_l(M) -> Q_l[R]; R acts faithfully and dim X_l(M)^J <= |R|/|J|. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extension to the normalizer
providers.scope: The restriction of an open homomorphism G_F -> P to an open normal subgroup U of G_Q extends uniquely to a continuous homomorphism beta on the normalizer G_k of its kernel, and beta is open. Assumes (U1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quotient amplification (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For an odd prime l and a finite quotient R_0 of P there is a totally imaginary Galois L/Q in Q^s, with group R mapping onto R_0, such that for every cyclic C in R and proper subgroup D of C some x in X_l(L)^D has E_C x = 0 and lies outside the invariants of the images of the conjugate kernels. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Frobenius generation (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For a finite quotient of P and an element gamma_0 there is a larger finite quotient R and a lift gamma such that the Frobenius images at infinitely many active primes of k generate <gamma>. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Surjectivity and cyclotomic logarithms (OpenAI)
providers.scope: beta: G_k -> P is surjective, and log chi_l o beta = log chi_{k,l} for every odd prime l = 1 mod [k:Q]!. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: l-adic Kummer theory
providers.scope: Kummer theory gives isomorphisms from the l-adic completion of F^x to H^1(G_F, Z_l(1)), and after tensoring with Q_l to H^1(G_F, Q_l(1)), compatible with field isomorphisms. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unramified Kummer classes
providers.scope: Kummer theory identifies O_{F,S}^x (x) Q_l with the classes in H^1(G_F, Q_l(1)) unramified at every finite prime outside S, compatibly with automorphisms preserving S. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The equivariant S-unit theorem
providers.scope: For a finite Galois extension K'/K with group Delta and a Delta-stable set S of places containing the archimedean ones, (O_{K',S}^x (x) Q_l) + Q_l is the permutation module Q_l[S]; the eigenspace of a character Delta -> Q_l^x has dimension at most the number of Delta-orbits on S. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite fibres (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For all but finitely many primes w of Q(i) above split rational primes, only finitely many primes of K form an active pair with w at some auxiliary prime. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A uniform bound on missed primes (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every auxiliary prime l in the infinite set of the fifth lesson, at most 2[K:Q] + 2 primes of Q(i) occur in no active pair at l. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separation by power residues
providers.scope: Given distinct primes q_j and finite sets P_j of primes not containing q_j, there are infinitely many odd primes l = 1 mod m, outside any finite set, with p^f mod l outside <q_j mod l> for all p in P_j and 1 <= f <= d. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matching residue characteristics (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For all but finitely many primes w of Q(i) above split rational primes q, some prime of K above the same q forms an active pair with w at some auxiliary prime. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Identification of the normalizer extension (OpenAI)
providers.scope: beta equals restriction G_k -> P followed by conjugation by an element of P. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Prosolvable rigidity (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every continuous homomorphism G_F -> Gal(Q^s/Q) with open image is conjugate in Gal(Q^s/Q) to restriction. Assumes (U1) and (U2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
